maml:description.maml:para: Connects to a Risk Management tenant
Connects to a Risk Management tenant to be able to run IdentityCommand.RiskMgmt module commands against it.
Provide either the ISPSS shared services subdomain (the Risk Management url is resolved automatically via platform discovery) or the Risk Management tenant url directly.
If an active `IdentityCommand` session is already present (established with `New-IDSession` or `New-IDPlatformToken`), it is used as-is.

Supply `-Credential` (or `-SAMLResponse`) and `Connect-RMTenant` will authenticate to CyberArk Identity first, replacing any existing session: the Identity tenant url is discovered from the same subdomain / url via platform discovery, then `New-IDSession` (interactive user, including any MFA challenges) or - with `-PlatformToken` - `New-IDPlatformToken` (OAuth `client_credentials`, for a service user) is invoked.
The ISPSS shared services subdomain of the Risk Management tenant. The Risk Management url is resolved from platform discovery and used for subsequent operations.

dev:remarks.maml:para: Resolves the Risk Management url for the `sometenant` shared services subdomain and connects to it, using the active `IdentityCommand` session, for subsequent module operations
Connects to the https://sometenant.compass.cyberark.cloud Risk Management tenant, using the active `IdentityCommand` session, for subsequent module operations

When no active `IdentityCommand` session is present, discovers the CyberArk Identity url for the `sometenant` subdomain, authenticates the user in `$Credential` (completing any MFA challenges), resolves the Risk Management url and connects to it
When no active `IdentityCommand` session is present, authenticates non-interactively as a service user via an OAuth platform token, then connects to the `sometenant` Risk Management tenant

maml:description.maml:para: Snoozes a finding

Snoozes a finding for a number of days. The finding's status changes to `SNOOZED` and it is excluded from risk summary counts until the snooze expires, at which point it reverts to its pre-snooze status.
Snoozing a finding which is already snoozed replaces the existing snooze.
Finding identifiers come from `Get-RMFinding`, and pipe into this command.
The identifier of the finding to snooze.
